title.narrative: Increased capacity of constituents to develop more resilient, inclusive and sustainable enterprises in supply chains and responsible business conduct for decent work

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area. (1) Policy briefs, sectoral toolkits and practical tools to share comparative knowledge and good practices. (2) An authoritative framework and source of data and statistics on decent work in supply chains derived from constituents, the ILO and other sources. (3) Research and documentation of good practices; development of tools for enterprises to uphold ILO standards and policies, promote social dialogue and collective action that addresses decent work in supply chains, and prevent and solve disputes at national, subnational, sectoral and global levels. (4) Promotion of the Tripartite Declaration of Principles concerning Multinational Enterprises and Social Policy (MNE Declaration) and all its operational tools, and strengthening of partnerships with international organizations to ensure consistent guidance and support on responsible business conduct to constituents.
